title.en: An Act to Repeal Executive Order Numbered Four Hundred Dated January Two Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Two and Executive Order Numbered Fifty-Eight Dated July Twenty-Six, Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Five
title.orig: An Act to Repeal Executive Order Numbered Four Hundred Dated January Two Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Two and Executive Order Numbered Fifty-Eight Dated July Twenty-Six, Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Five

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_54_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Executive Order Numbered Four hundred dated January two, nineteen hundred and forty-two and Executive Order Numbered Fifty-eight dated July twenty-six, nineteen hundred and forty-five are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: October 10, 1946.
